title: Wrong shape in package
text: Wrong shape in package. I ordered a 60" x 84" oblong table cloth. The package said it was oblong. However, when I opened the tablecloth it was an oval shape. Doesn't fit on my rectangular table. It is made in China you could see the dark wood table threw the white tablecloth. If you want this pattern to show nicely, put a white table cloth under this one. And double check the size inside the package to make sure you have the right size.

The colorful design includes shades of brown, red, green, and white with dashes of blue snowflakes. The tablecloth has a wonderful texture and enough weight to lie perfectly centered on your table and is available in a variety of shapes, including rectangle/oblong and round, so you’re sure to find the perfect fit for your table. To keep this cloth table cover looking amazing, simply machine wash and dry it.
